### Azure SQL

#### [Build locally, ship to Azure: meet Azure SQL Developer](https://devblogs.microsoft.com/azure-sql/azure-sql-developer-prpr/)

Azure SQL - `private-preview` / `updated` - Medium impact

Big news: Azure SQL Developer is here, in private preview. It’s the Azure SQL Database engine, on your laptop, in a container. Build against the exact engine you run in the cloud. Ship the same code to Azure. Change one line, the connection string, and you’re in production. Free for local dev and CI. No subscription.
